"""In-process audit trail. Production ships these entries to the ledger service."""

from .clock import utcnow

_EVENTS: list[dict] = []


def record(event: str, **fields) -> dict:
    entry = {"event": event, "at": utcnow(), **fields}
    _EVENTS.append(entry)
    return entry


def events(event: str | None = None) -> list[dict]:
    return [e for e in _EVENTS if event is None or e["event"] == event]

from datetime import datetime, timezone
from decimal import Decimal
from ledgerly.adjustments import outage_refund, APPROVAL_THRESHOLD
from ledgerly.models import Payment
from ledgerly.errors import BillingError

T0 = datetime(2026,10,1,tzinfo=timezone.utc)
print("threshold", APPROVAL_THRESHOLD)

def mk(amt="2000.00"):
    return Payment("p","i",Decimal(amt),status="captured",created_at=T0,captured_at=T0)

# at threshold: no approval needed
p=mk(); outage_refund(p, Decimal("1000.00"), T0); print("at threshold ok", p.refunded_amount)
# above threshold without approval
p=mk()
try: outage_refund(p, Decimal("1000.01"), T0)
except BillingError as e: print("above no approval:", e.code)
# above threshold with approval
p=mk(); outage_refund(p, Decimal("1000.01"), T0, approved_by="mgr"); print("approved ok", p.refunded_amount)
# full refund sets status
p=mk("50.00"); outage_refund(p, Decimal("50.00"), T0); print("status", p.status)
# partial then full
p=mk("50.00"); outage_refund(p, Decimal("20.00"), T0); print("partial", p.refunded_amount, p.status)
outage_refund(p, Decimal("30.00"), T0); print("full", p.refunded_amount, p.status)
# exceeds
p=mk("50.00")
try: outage_refund(p, Decimal("60.00"), T0)
except BillingError as e: print("exceeds:", e.code)
# non-positive
p=mk()
try: outage_refund(p, Decimal("0"), T0)
except BillingError as e: print("zero:", e.code)
# not captured
p=Payment("p","i",Decimal("10"),status="authorized",created_at=T0)
try: outage_refund(p, Decimal("1"), T0)
except BillingError as e: print("state:", e.code)
EOF
